title: [Master] - Bug 654115: [Expense Agent] Cannot submit report with a non-refundable Employee Paid line: 'nothing to refund' blocks release, report stuck in draft
summary: Fixes an issue where expense reports with non-refundable employee paid lines couldn't be submitted due to a 'nothing to refund' error that blocked the release process.
key_points: Users can now release and submit expense reports containing non-refundable employee paid lines
The validation that blocked submission for non-refundable lines has been corrected
Additional test cases ensure the fix handles various expense report scenarios
Changes in post management and release logic prevent the erroneous error message
